case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar. Need: 94800 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 10 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200008. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70710.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

message.subject: Round bar 1.4404 - price basis with your AS-14404 clause
message.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

thank you for your letter of 12 September. We are ready to agree a 36-month term with your AS-14404 clause (45% share, August 2026 base).

We also buy this bar from a second source: our orders of part:370010 (po:4500014022-10, po:4500014078-10) were placed at EUR 5.26 per kg.
Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).
Our volume forecast for part:370010 changed by +1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09).

On this basis we propose EUR 4.95 per kg with the clause, 30 days, 36 months.

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

response.subject: Re: Round bar 1.4404 - price basis with your AS-14404 clause
response.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. The price history data you cite does not concern this part or our company. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. We welcome your proposal for a 36-month contract and the inclusion of the AS-14404 index clause, which allows us to adjust our base price. While we acknowledge the slight decrease in PPI-C2431, prices from other sources or for different parts do not influence our calculation. Based on the extended contract term and the index clause, we are pleased to offer a revised price of EUR 5.66 per kg. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.

Our revised Angebot stands at a price of €5.66 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

message.subject: Re: Round bar 1.4404 - price basis
message.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

thank you for moving. Our second source supplies the same bar at EUR 5.26. We can move to EUR 5.16 per kg with the clause, 30 days, 36 months.

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

response.subject: Re: Round bar 1.4404 - price basis
response.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your revised offer. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We are always glad to work with you and support your requirements from our broad inventory and service offering.

We can reduce our price to EUR 5.55 per kg for the 36-month contract with the AS-14404 clause and 30 days payment. To be precise, our offer stands at a price of €5.55 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 36 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Please note that our offer remains valid for 30 days.

Regarding the alternative source you mentioned, please provide documentation so we can review the basis of this claim. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

response.subject: Re: Round bar 1.4404 - price basis
response.body:
Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.
Our terms: a price of €5.51 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
A few words on this from our side.
Thank you for your revised offer.
We are prepared to lower our price to EUR 5.51 per kg for the 36-month contract with the AS-14404 clause and 30 days payment.
As we have not received the requested documentation regarding your alternative source, we cannot factor it into our calculation.
Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.
Our conditions follow our Preisliste and discount tiers.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
